rationale: C04 supplies an almost verbatim template for the child: the same three-part recital sequence, the same National Mediation Board finding concerning interruption of interstate commerce and deprivation of essential transportation service, the same thirty-day reporting requirement, and the same section 10 prohibition on changing the conditions underlying the dispute. The child principally substitutes the carrier and employee representative. C08 and C23 use the same machinery and nearly identical language but are older than C04.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas a dispute exists between the Southern Pacific Company (Pacific Lines), a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Firemen and Enginemen, a labor organization
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Northwest Airlines, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Association of Machinists, a labor organization
shared_material.explanation: Identical opening formula with the parties and union substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended

shared_material.child_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a large section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a large section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive operative factual predicate is verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made
shared_material.explanation: Verbatim status-quo machinery, adapted only to the new carrier and employees.
